> Your origin returned a response Cloudflare could not parse: an empty reply, headers that are too large, a connection dropped part-way through, or malformed…

The fastest route to the cause is your origin's error log at the moment of failure, matched to the Cloudflare Ray ID shown on the error page. The most commonly missed cause is oversized response headers, usually from cookies that have quietly grown too large.
